# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_FLIP_BOS_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA8 crosses below EMA13 (ribbon flip to bearish) coinciding with a bearish break of structure (lower low) on elevated volume, short-term momentum often accelerates. This captures the early stage of a bearish impulse where the ribbon flip signals weakening bullish momentum and the BOS confirms seller control, especially when volume confirms participation.

## Mechanism

Entry: On a 5-minute bar, if previous bar EMA8 > EMA13 and current bar EMA8 < EMA13 (ribbon flip bearish) AND price makes a new lower low (BOS) relative to the prior bar's low AND volume > 1.5x the average volume of the prior 5 five-minute bars, then go short at the close of that bar. Exit: initial stop is chart-stop at the recent swing high (prior higher high before entry), TP1 at 1.5R (risk-reward), and if TP1 hits, trail the remaining position with a 12% trailing stop from the high-water mark. Additionally, only consider entries when VIX is between 15-25 and time is between 10:30-13:30 ET; avoid entries when price > VWAP for >80% of the last 20 minutes (strong bullish trend).
